hypothesis_additions.claim: Coinbase's minority Circle equity stake and revenue-sharing arrangement incentivize USDC distribution and platform balances, strengthening the USDC ecosystem.
hypothesis_additions.counterevidence: Coinbase's share of average USDC on-platform balances declined in Circle's H1 2026 comparison even while total USDC circulation grew; Coinbase's stablecoin revenue fell 5% YoY in Q3 2026.

hypothesis_additions.claim: Falling reserve yields can reduce Circle reserve income and Coinbase stablecoin revenue even when USDC balances grow.
hypothesis_additions.counterevidence: Higher USDC circulation and average balances can partially offset lower reserve yields; Circle's 100bp sensitivity holds circulation constant and is not a forecast.

hypothesis_additions.claim: Circle's USDC deployment on XRPL and Coinbase's XRP/cbXRP custody could be complementary to XRPL ecosystem growth.
hypothesis_additions.counterevidence: No evidence in the filings establishes material Coinbase USDC distribution on XRPL, USDC-to-XRP conversion flow, or a causal relationship between Circle's distribution payments and XRP demand.

hypothesis_additions.claim: SBI Holdings' separate investments/partnerships with Circle and Ripple make SBI an indirect strategic bridge between both ecosystems.
hypothesis_additions.counterevidence: No evidence establishes coordinated capital allocation, shared governance, or an SBI VC Trade stablecoin route on XRPL; current VCTRADE network support lists USDC/RLUSD on Ethereum and JPYSC transfers unsupported.

economic_relationship.coinbase_circle_distribution_formula: issuer retention + party product economics + 50% of remaining payment base to Coinbase after approved participants
